name: Inamori Nayuta
source:
A quiet, gentle woman with a mysterious aura. She is a delicate beauty, though not particularly curvy.

She is the priestess at Inamori Shrine, and on sunny afternoons, she can often be seen sweeping the grounds with a broom in a leisurely manner.

[From [url=https://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/premiumbox/soft/boin/]official site[/url]]
